integrity: The transition matrix is generated by exhaustive legal-flip enumeration and exact combinatorial isomorphism canonicalization from a published facet list. No numerical approximation is used.
scientific_limitations: Exact only for the six eight-vertex combinatorial types and vertex-preserving \(2\)-\(2\) bistellar flips; no claim is made about paths through larger triangulations or geometric immersions.
title: Exact \(2\)-\(2\) flip graph of the six eight-vertex Klein-bottle triangulations
